summary: Canonical request telemetry metric-name bindings for implemented messenger, mail, social, and community REST write routes.
claim_boundary: Runtime-free telemetry binding only. No OpenTelemetry exporter, Prometheus registry, live metric emission, SLO burn exercise, circuit-breaker runtime, or production observability claim.

facets.F1_simplicity: A shared `RequestTelemetryBinding` value type centralizes canonical metric names; REST crates only expose operation-specific bindings.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: Honest non-claim: route metric names are now deterministic, but runtime emission, burn alerts, dashboards, and backpressure/circuit-breaker behavior remain pending.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests reject invalid operation-id labels and verify exact canonical metric names for every implemented write route.
facets.F5_quality: cargo test, clippy -D warnings, cargo fmt --check, dependency-seam, honest-claims, data-class audit, and diff hygiene are part of this evidence run.
facets.F7_security_privacy: Operation IDs are low-cardinality route labels; tenant/principal/request values are not added to metric names.
facets.F11_observability: Messenger, mail, social, and community write routes now map to canonical request_total, request_success_total, responses_total, responses_5xx_total, and responses_429_total names for future runtime adapters.
